pgf.mod.name: Prismatic Gem Filter
pgf.page.title: Prismatic Gem Filter
pgf.page.desc: Prismatic Gem lets card rewards offer cards from other classes. The lists below group the cards that other classes almost never use.
pgf.master.name: Enable filtering
pgf.master.desc: Off makes this mod do nothing.
pgf.mode.name: When to filter
pgf.mode.desc: Keep the default value if you are not sure.
pgf.section.necrobinder: Osty, Summon, and Doom are Necrobinder mechanics.
pgf.section.defect: Orbs and Focus are Defect mechanics.
pgf.section.silent: Sly, Shiv, and Poison are Silent mechanics.
pgf.section.regent: Forge and Stars are Regent mechanics.
pgf.section.fool: Arrows and Impale are Fool mechanics.
pgf.section.cross: These cards appear only in multiplayer.

pgf.exempt.page.title: Exempt cards
pgf.exempt.page.desc: A selected card stays. If the card is also in another group, that group can still exclude it.
